282124107.description: Large mixed lot containing rocks, minerals, crystals, and gemstones. Includes IMI Educational Outreach Rock Kit and Grandpa Shorter's rock identification kit with compartmentalized plastic cases. Labeled rock types include limestone, dolomite, granite, sandstone, shale, marble, gravel, gneiss/schist, basalt, and slate. Metallic ore specimens such as pyrite are included. Contains an amethyst cluster with embedded pyrite, polished tumbled stones including rose quartz, moonstone, opalite, aventurine, sodalite, tiger's eye, and bloodstone. Also features raw quartz crystal clusters, an agate slice pendant with drilled hole, coral fossil fragments, a possible shark tooth fossil, driftwood pieces, and various unpolished rough mineral specimens in earth tones. Items vary in size from small stones to palm-sized specimens. Wear present on items. See photos for condition.

282431270.description:
Natural Amethyst Crystal Cluster Geode Specimen
Raw Deep Purple Quartz Mineral Specimen
Natural Stone, Approximately 12.6 x 7 x 5 Inches, 14.4 lbs
This striking natural amethyst geode cluster features a deep purple crystalline basin with well-formed quartz points set within a natural rock and agate matrix rim. Weighing over 14 pounds, this substantial geological display piece exhibits rich violet coloration and sparkling crystal terminations throughout the interior cavity, making it an impressive centerpiece for mineral collectors and home decor displays.
Genuine raw amethyst crystal cluster geode formation
Deep purple quartz points with natural polished agate edge banding
Heavy basalt matrix backing provides a stable display base
Measures approximately 12.6 inches long by 7 inches wide and 5 inches high; weighs 14.4 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in very good condition with intact crystal points throughout the main cavity. Typical minor natural variations, fissures, and rough matrix texture inherent to natural stone formations. Back matrix shows painted inventory numbers. Sturdy and display-ready.
Only includes what is shown in pictures, any accessories or items not shown but described cannot be guaranteed to be included with the lot.
